directive: **Configure** — right after Discovery, decide which OPTIONAL capabilities this project needs and record them with `bsc plan classify set` (a JSON object on stdin). From the discovery findings + the pitch, determine: (1) `uiMode` — `custom` if the UI is generated IN-APP (the designer builds a live, navigable shell you preview as you plan — the default for most apps) or `external` if the user brings their own design files to drop in; (2) which of the OFF-by-default optional stages the project genuinely needs — `needsSource` (migrating data FROM a legacy system: a CRM/ERP/SaaS/database), `needsMcp` (the fleet's agents need external tools or data via MCP servers), `needsSkills` (a reusable skill library is worth authoring for this project), `needsAutomations` (scheduled / cron jobs). MOST projects need NONE of the optional stages — turn one on ONLY if the project truly requires it, and ASK the user to confirm before enabling. Examples: `{"uiMode":"custom"}` for a simple app; `{"uiMode":"custom","needsSource":true}` for a data migration. Enabling a stage makes it appear in the plan for you to complete. Gate: the classification is recorded.
name: Configure

require.label: record which optional stages the project needs

blurb: Decide which optional capabilities the project needs — integrations, MCP servers, skills, automations — plus the UI mode.
prompt:
Right after Discovery, decide which OPTIONAL capabilities this project needs and record them with
`bsc plan classify set` (a JSON object on stdin). Set `uiMode` (`custom` = an in-app generated UI, the
default; `external` = the user brings their own design files). Then enable ONLY the optional stages the
project genuinely needs: `needsSource` (migrating from a legacy system), `needsMcp` (agents need external
tools via MCP servers), `needsSkills` (a reusable skill library), `needsAutomations` (scheduled jobs).
Most projects need none of these — ASK the user to confirm before turning one on. Enabling a stage makes
it appear in the plan.

Gate: the classification is recorded.
